Also on the books

How it goes

Four steps, no mystery.

  1. 1

    Have a chat

    Ring or send through the form. Tell us what you are after and what the place is like.

    Easy.

  2. 2

    Site visit

    Alex comes out, gets on the roof or opens the board, and works out what actually suits.

    Easy.

  3. 3

    A proper quote

    A written price for the job in front of you. No pressure, no sales pitch, no follow-up pestering.

    Easy.

  4. 4

    Install day

    Same bloke who quoted it does the work, cleans up after himself and shows you how it runs.

    Easy.

Know what you want? Or no idea at all?

Both are fine. Ring for a chat or send the details through and we will work it out from there.
